== Summary ==
Slip “•Sacrifice For Something Bigger (Front) / •Sacrifice For Something Bigger (Back)” cut unchanged from page 4 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF file created 13 October 2026), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 826, 1624, 1513)). Version [[Sacrifice For Something Bigger (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
